decisive_sectors.description: This sits on a slower climb where extra watts return more time than on the faster parts of the route. The current plan is worth about 4.4s here versus constant power.
This is a late-race sector on a slower climb, so arriving with reserve matters. The current plan is worth about 9.2s here versus constant power.

This is a late-race sector on mixed-cost terrain, so arriving with reserve matters. It lasts long enough that pacing mistakes tend to stick. The current plan is worth about 4.7s here versus constant power.

plan_rationale: Pushes where the road is slow (climbs, rough surfaces) and eases where it is fast, which is 9.6 s quicker than holding the same average power steadily.
Uses your W' down to the 0.0 kJ floor without going below it.
The biggest swing point is interval 6 around 8.2-8.5 km, worth about 9.2s versus constant pacing on its own.
